scope: Version-aware advanced inference chapter with original diagram and explicit toy/derived claims.

claims.claim: Pipeline parallelism distributes different model layers to separate stages; vLLM documents combining PP with TP for multi-node inference.
claims.locator: Distributed inference strategies and Single-node deployment

claims.claim: Microbatch pipeline parallelism and the pipeline-bubble framing originate from GPipe (Huang et al., 2019); Megatron-LM (Shoeybi et al., 2019) is a foundational large-model model-parallel implementation.
claims.locator: GPipe pipeline scheduling and bubble discussion; Megatron-LM at arXiv:1909.08053
claims.notes: The chapter cites these works for the mechanism and terminology only; it does not reuse training-time pipeline-efficiency numbers as inference guarantees.

claims.claim: Dense-model data parallel deployment replicates weights across ranks and processes independent batches of requests.
Current docs distinguish per-rank max_num_seqs from server-level max_num_queued_reqs and max_num_queued_tokens admission controls.
For MoE models with DP, expert layers may require coordinated forwards and rank synchronization, so DP ranks are not always fully independent.
With enable-expert-parallel, the documented EP size is computed as TP_SIZE multiplied by DP_SIZE.
Expert parallelism distributes experts and moves token activations to the matching devices and back, with backend-dependent All-to-All behavior.
claims.locator: Communication Backend and Single Node Deployment

claims.claim: Sparsely-gated mixture-of-experts with Top-k routing was introduced by Shazeer et al. (2017), and distributing MoE experts across devices as Expert Parallelism was systematized in GShard (Lepikhin et al., 2020).
claims.locator: GShard MoE expert partitioning; sparsely-gated MoE at arXiv:1701.06538
claims.notes: The chapter cites these for the routing and multi-device dispatch mechanism, not for any reported speed or quality result.

claims.claim: The article's DP×TP×PP simple GPU count is a resource-planning heuristic; true rank topology and multi-node configuration may add constraints.
claims.notes: Not a universal performance scaling equation.
